description: Build a login API that validates user credentials and returns a secure authentication response.
requirements: Repository should include user registration or seeded test user setup
Login endpoint should validate email or username and password
Passwords should be hashed and should not be stored in plain text
Successful login should return a token or session response without exposing sensitive user data
Invalid login should return an appropriate error response without leaking whether a user exists
Repository should include tests or documented sample requests for success and failure login cases
title: Build Secure Login API
